title: Accelerator Plan Input
description: JSON schema for the minimal plan fragment consumed by PlanJsonPlaceholder.Parse(). Maps to protobuf PlanEnvelope (accel_plan.proto) with PlanVersion=1.

mode.description: Execution mode. Set to 'vector' for vector operations (DOT, COSINE, L2). Omit or set to null for aggregate mode.

operation.description: Operation to perform. Aggregate mode: SUM, COUNT, MIN, MAX, AVG. Vector mode: DOT, COSINE, L2.

agg.description: Aggregate configuration. Only used in aggregate mode (mode != 'vector').

col.description: 1-based PostgreSQL attribute number for the aggregate target column.

columns.description: Array of column descriptors referenced by the plan. Maps to Plan.columns in protobuf.

predicate.description: Optional filter clauses applied with AND semantics before aggregation. Maps to Plan.predicate.clauses in protobuf.

attno.description: 1-based PostgreSQL attribute number of the column to filter.

val.description: Constant right-hand side value for the comparison (float64).
